Welcome to The Tiny Herd, a channel dedicated to sharing everyday pet care for guinea pigs and other small pets! I share cage cleans, pet supply hauls, guinea pig care guides, and DIY pet projects!

🐹 Come hang out with us!
http://www.thetinyherd.com
http://instagram.com/thetinyherd
http://tiktok.com/thetinyherd
http://pinterest.com/thetinyherd

🐰 For all press or sponsorships inquiries, email allison@thetinyherd.com.

This channel shares my experience and my knowledge, but I am not a veterinarian. It is for entertainment and educational purposes only. Please seek the help of a veterinarian if you have any health or medical questions about your animals!
